verdict: Leads are arriving efficiently — but none are reaching your pipeline yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 47 leads at a cost per lead of $36.51 — the most efficient result on record, with cost per lead dropping 45.11% over the most recent 7 days. The ads are working. The problem is downstream: of those 47 leads, none converted into a tracked opportunity, meaning leads are arriving but not being captured and followed up in your intake system. Automated follow-up via SMS and phone access is not yet live, which means leads are likely going cold before contact is made. Getting those tools active is the immediate priority, and until they are, we are holding spend at current levels rather than scaling.

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not entering your pipeline — automated SMS follow-up and phone access are not yet active, so inbound leads are going cold before contact is made.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and phone access setup are being prioritized now; once live, lead response time drops to minutes and pipeline conversion tracking becomes reliable.
